query:
UPDATE business_expense_claims
            SET status = $3,
                approved_amount = $4::NUMERIC,
                decision_reason = $5,
                approved_by_account_id = $6,
                approved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                version = version + 1,
                updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND status = 'submitted'
            RETURNING id
